newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso closes higher vs dollar at 1,058.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso closes higher vs dollar at 1,058.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed 2.45 pesos higher against the dollar at 1,058 as banks sold greenbacks to build up their peso positions in advance of the long Easter holidays, interbank dealers said.
They said there was little activity involving the corporate sector and the market moved almost entirely on the basis of a traditional cash-crunch ahead of the holiday.
Dealers reported 387 trades for $160 million and said the peso traded in an average range of 1,059.95 before strengthening ahead of the close.
